post.description: Registers a patient with Curai Health and returns an access token.

street.title: Street
street.description: The street address. Also referred to as address line 1 and line 2. Please include the name of the street, the number of the building, and any other identifying information such as an apartment or suite number.

city.title: City
city.description: The name of the patient's city.

zip_code.title: Zip Code
zip_code.description: The patient's zip code. We only serve patients residing in the United States.

unique_id.title: Unique Id
unique_id.description: A unique identifier for the patient.

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Datetime with timezone the service will end on.

unique_id.title: Unique Id
unique_id.description: A unique identifier for the patient.

first_name.title: First Name
first_name.description: The patient's first name. This will be used as the patient's legal name.

sex.title: Sex
sex.description: The patient's biological sex. Gender and pronouns are not collected at the time of registration.

permanent_address.title: Permanent Address
permanent_address.description: The patient's address. This will be used as the patient's permanent address.

email.title: Email
email.description: The patient's email address. This email will be used for notifications and contacting the patient when needed.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: The patient's phone number. This number will be used for notifications and contacting the patient when needed.

patient.title: Patient
patient.description: The data for the patient who is seeking care.

primary_account_holder_unique_id.title: Primary Account Holder Unique Id
primary_account_holder_unique_id.description: A unique identifier for the patient.If the patient seeking care is a pediatric patient or a dependent, this id refers to the patient's sponsor, legal guardian, or policy holder. Otherwise, this id should match the unique_id provided in the patient object.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Any additional metadata that is specific to your organization and patients. Please reach out to support if you have any questions.

access_token.title: Access Token
access_token.description: Authentication token to bypass the need to login to our app.

refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: Token used to obtain a new access token when the current one expires.

auth_url.title: Auth Url
auth_url.description: An authentication url that can be used to login directly to our app.
